# Prometric

> Prometric is a global leader in computer-based testing and exam administration, offering comprehensive test delivery platforms, scheduling services, and support tools for certification programs and standardized assessments.

Prometric operates multiple integrated platforms including eHelp support services, AP&C test delivery systems, and ProAdmin test center management tools. The company serves diverse markets across America and EMEA regions, administering exams ranging from professional certifications (DSST, TOEFL) to specialized assessments.

## Key Topics

- Test Delivery Platforms
- Exam Registration & Scheduling
- eHelp Support Center
- AP&C Platform
- ProAdmin
- Test Center Management
- Appointment Management
- Exam Administration
- Certification Programs
- Technical Support
- Multilingual Support
- Test Scheduling
- Reschedule/Cancel
- Test Center Locator
- Operational Support

## Test Scheduling & Registration

- [Prometric - Welcome](https://qc-securereg3.prometric.com/): Main test scheduling and exam registration portal for candidates to book appointments and manage exam registration

## Reporting & Analytics

- [LogIn](https://reports.prometric.com/): Prometric Reports self-service web reporting portal for accessing test delivery analytics and operational reports

## Support & Help Resources

- [Prometric | eHelp](https://ehelp.prometric.com/): Help center for Prometric eHelp and AP&C test delivery platforms with technical and operational support documentation
